title: Coherent Content
description: Small implementation that fixes some of the inconsistencies and mechanics of the game
body:
# Coherent Content

Coherent Content expands Minecraft by adding unique and quirky features that bring a touch of realism and absurdity to the game. From cooking octopus tentacles to crafting saddles, this mod introduces items and mechanics that fill in some gaps in Minecraft’s content.

## ✅Features
1. **Fried Eggs:** Now you can cook eggs in the smoker to get fried eggs, adding a new food source to the game.
   
1. **Octopus Tentacles:** Squids now drop tentacles when they die, which can be cooked in the smoker. Eating them raw has a chance to poison you.
   
1. **Craftable Saddles:** Saddles can now be crafted using iron, string, and reinforced leather. Reinforced leather is made by combining one piece of leather with eight iron ingots.
   
1. **Horse Armor Crafting:** Craft horse armor with a smithing template, leather armor, and your choice of metal to make it from.
   
1. **Arrow Recipe Changes:** Arrows now require iron nuggets instead of flint, altering the crafting process for a more metallic feel.
   
1. **Human Meat:** Upon death, players drop “human meat,” just as other animals drop their respective meats, adding an eerie twist to the survival experience.

## 📖Why Use Coherent Content?
This mod is perfect for players looking to add bizarre yet fitting content to Minecraft. Coherent Content enhances gameplay by introducing items that are both functional and fun, appealing to players who want a slightly unconventional Minecraft experience.
